display.title: Episode 407: The Storyteller, Chapter 1 (Kislev)
display.summary_short: Kislev, the month of miracles: unity through a letter in the children's Sefer Torah, a class's Shema, and chapter 1 of the Baal Shem Tov's storyteller.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in Kislev 5750, shortly before Yud-Tes Kislev and Chanukah. Uncle Yossi recalls the Rebbe's blessing that 5750 be a year of miracles, especially in Kislev, the month of the Chanukah miracle. In the Chanukah story the Jewish people were saved in the merit of unity, and nothing unites us like the Torah, so the Rebbe urges every child to buy a letter in the new children's Sefer Torah and to share the mitzvah with relatives and friends, just as the menorah's candles burn together. After the Hakochainik march, a first-grade class from Beis Yaakov of Boro Park recites the Shema, listeners say amen for a sick person's recovery, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins a new serial, 'The Storyteller'. Days before his passing, the Baal Shem Tov gives each of his students a mission for life: teacher, shochet, rabbi. Last comes Rabbi Yehuda, his devoted shamash, whose family had gone without because of his service. The Baal Shem Tov makes him a storyteller, to tell everywhere of the wonders he witnessed, and promises that this will bring him great wealth if he is patient and never gives up. The show closes with a reminder that even newborns can join Tzivos Hashem, and a first-birthday wish for a baby's full recovery.
display.lesson: Unite through the Torah and share mitzvos with others; trust a tzaddik's blessing and be patient.
